description: Prepare a time-limited signed quote for a plan_id selected using search_plans or get_plan. Returns quote_id, current price and customer-confirmation requirements; the quoted price is locked for 30 minutes, but no order, payment, or eSIM is created. Next call create_checkout for customer-paid Stripe Checkout or purchase for an enabled alternate method.

lang.description: Language for names and texts (default en).
